verdict.rationale: cubic's docs describe an interactive-comments feature for asking questions, triggering reviews, and fixing issues in PR comments, either by tagging @cubic-dev-ai or by replying to its existing comments to continue the conversation. The quickstart shows replying to a review comment to ask for clarification, and documents commands such as `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`, Ultrareview requests, and fixes pushed to the PR branch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-thread conversational answers, and detailed documentation of how replies use thread and code context.
